strategy.thesis: Bitcoin-focused venture firm accelerating Bitcoin adoption across Asia — from broad Web3 investing in Fund I to operational acquisition of publicly traded companies implementing Bitcoin treasury strategies.

summary.en: Taipei-based, Bitcoin-focused crypto venture firm founded in 2018 by Jason Fang. Deployed $28M in Fund I across 70+ companies; now raising a $1B Bitcoin treasury flagship fund (Fund III) targeting Asian public companies. Over 100 portfolio companies across three funds.
summary.local: 總部設於台北 101 的比特幣導向加密創投，2018 年由 Jason Fang 創立。Fund I 投入 2,800 萬美元、投資 70 多家公司，目前正募集 10 億美元的比特幣金庫旗艦基金 (Fund III)。三檔基金累計投資超過 100 家公司。
